title: Run callers on real + confounder panel; report sensitivity + specificity
context: M3 specificity evaluation for the EWSR1-fusion detection benchmark. Runs all callers over the curated real positives and the confounder panel to report sensitivity alongside specificity - the project's check that callers do not mislabel non-ES EWSR1 look-alikes as ES fusions. Uses accession-fetched open data only, with full provenance and CI-bounded metrics; no patient-facing claim is produced.
objective: Run the caller harness over the real positives + confounder panel and report sensitivity and specificity with CI + n + provenance per stratum.
acceptanceCriteria: All callers run on the real positives + confounder panel via the existing harness with complete provenance.
Sensitivity and specificity reported per stratum with CI + n (via the scoring library).
Confounder false-positives (non-ES EWSR1 calls) reported explicitly.
output: A pull request adding the specificity run + output/specificity-report with sensitivity/specificity metrics.
